ety: เทียบลาว ເຫ (เห) (ในคำว่า ຫັນເຫ (หันเห)), พ่าเก ꩭေ︀ (เห)
rule: เห has almost no compounds. Of 18 words queued, 16 are not compounds at all: they are single syllables spelt with a leading ห (ห นำ), the silent high-class tone marker that Thai writes before a sonorant — เหลา /law/, เหงา /ŋaw/, เหล้า /law/. The corpus's own IPA proves it: a real compound of เห contains the syllable /heː/ and these contain one syllable and no /h/. The two that survive are both V+V synonym compounds in which the first element supplies the MANNER of the deflection and เห supplies the deflection itself — หัน 'turn' gradually, หัก 'snap' sharply — so both file under the core. Senses 2 (เขว, going astray) and 3 (เฉ, leaning off true) take no compounds; they are one-word senses.

notes.h2: 2026-09-06 — เห, กำ, กล · and 637 compounds filed by a method the brief disowns
notes.text:
**The corpus proved it against itself.** A real compound of เห contains /heː/. Every one
of the 16 is ONE syllable and has no /h/ at all: เหลา /law˩˩˦/, เหงา /ŋaw˩˩˦/,
เหลือ /lɯa̯˩˩˦/. The second consonant is a sonorant in all sixteen — น ม ง ย ร ล ว,
exactly the class ห นำ operates on — and the tones run the ห นำ paradigm cleanly
(rising bare, low with mai ek, falling with mai tho). Zero exceptions in sixteen.
Ten are `verified`: Proto-Tai single etyma (*ʰlɯəᴬ, *ʰnawᴮ¹, *ʰlawᴬ¹, *ʰlenꟲ, *ʰlawꟲ),
a Cantonese loan (เหม่ง < 明), a derivation (เหรอ < หรือ < ฤๅ), and three that RID itself
glosses as a respelling of one other word (เหน้า = เน่า, เหล้ม = เล่ม, เหล้น = เล่น).
Six are `standard` — cognate lists or no etymology, carried by the IPA alone.

notes.h2: 2026-09-06 — เห, กำ, กล · and 637 compounds filed by a method the brief disowns
notes.text:
> **The brief's borrowing test does not catch these.** It says a borrowed word's
> etymology OPENS with ยืมมาจาก. Not one of these sixteen does. They are *inherited*
> (สืบทอดจาก) or cognate-listed. This is a second false-split generator — orthographic,
> not lexical — and it needs its own test.

notes.h2: 2026-09-06 — เห, กำ, กล · and 637 compounds filed by a method the brief disowns
notes.text:
**Unsure:** หักเห under 1 rather than 3. The argument for 3 (เฉ, 'leaning off true') is
that หักเห is the physics term for refraction and มุมหักเห is measured off the normal —
literally leaning off true. I did not take it because RID's leading gloss is เปลี่ยนทางไป,
a change of *path*, not of angle, and because หันเห's gloss เบนจากเดิม uses sense 1's own
verb เบน and the two are near-synonyms that should not be split apart. Thin call.
